_comment_0829: jwc-26-0829-0050: v0.51.0 -- login payload in quest_Dashboard_Network_SendLogin_Func was a bare copy of the header global, so the sender prepended the same string twice and login went out as 'B50:07,B50:07'. Now sends 'Me:' + control.deviceName(), giving 'B50:07,Me:B50'. Controller is unaffected: it matches payload keys against ID#/CH#/S1L/S0R/S3L/S2R/S7L/S6R, and neither the old key nor 'Me' is in that list, so the field was and remains inert. Numbering skips 0.50.0 -- that tag exists on a wheel-mirror commit that was reverted in 341c7f2.
_comment: jwc-26-0820-1640: OLED12864_I2C fork pin v2.0.1 -> v2.0.2, which ADDS buffered drawing primitives (bufPixel/bufHline/bufVline/bufRect/bufFillRect/bufClear) plus drawPages() partial-region flush. That release is purely additive -- no pre-existing exported function changed -- so quest_Dashboard's OLED text path in custom.ts behaves identically. The bump exists so the bot project can draw real graphics (DriverDashboard screens 5-9); pxt resolves ONE version per package, so this pin and any direct pin in a consuming project MUST stay identical.
